attributes.board_name: Connecticut Department of Public Health (Board of Veterinary Medicine)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, including online, offered or approved by national or state veterinary medical organizations, societies or associations, veterinary colleges and other appropriate professional organizations; the Department does not pre-approve courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time renewal applicants are exempt until the next registration period.
rules.alternatives: Notarized exemption if not in active practice; waiver or extension for medical disability or illness with physician certification.
rules.audit_note: Keep records 3 years after the year completed; submit within 45 days of a Department request.
rules.notes: License is renewed every year (one-year registration period); the 24 contact hours are counted over the preceding 24 months. 1 contact hour = 50 min. CE must be in the licensee's area of practice. Reinstatement needs 12 h in the prior year.
rules.rule_quote: (b) Except as otherwise provided in this section, for registration periods beginning on and after July 1, 2011, a licensee applying for license renewal shall earn a minimum of twenty-four contact hours of continuing education within the preceding twenty-four- month period.
